name: cool-blonde-girl-selfie
image_purpose: Fashion selfie post and hallway outfit visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body fashion selfie on a marble staircase landing.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair and full straight bangs, playful wink and pout, making a peace sign near her face. She wears an oversized blue denim jacket over a black turtleneck, a long black skirt with a white side stripe, silver necklace and ring, and carries the cream-white Coach handbag shown in the reference, preserving its visible supplied markings without inventing new logos.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body low-angle portrait on a staircase landing, subject leaning forward slightly with relaxed playful posture. Include marble stairs and walls, warm hallway lighting, brass handrails, and accurate handbag placement.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm natural indoor hallway light with soft shadows and gentle highlights on denim, marble, hair, and handbag, mischievous fun mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone fashion-selfie look, low-angle full-body frame, high-resolution photorealism, realistic fabric and marble texture, subtle grain, sharp subject detail, natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic full-body fashion selfie of one approved adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair and full straight bangs, winking with a playful pout and making a peace sign near her face. She wears an oversized blue denim jacket over a black turtleneck, a long black skirt with a white side stripe, a silver necklace and ring, and carries the cream-white Coach handbag shown in the reference with its supplied markings preserved. She leans slightly forward on a marble staircase landing with warm hallway lighting, brass handrails, realistic denim, marble, hair, and handbag texture, a low-angle smartphone perspective, and mischievous cool fashion energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, invented or altered brand markings, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
